units.source_text: 我出走的直接动机，是由于头天老师第一次以坚决的口吻明确地说：

en.t: The immediate reason I ran away was that the day before, for the first time, the teacher had said clearly and in a firm tone:

units.source_text: "我曾经打算让你接我的班，不过现在我必须明确地告诉你，

en.t: "I once intended to have you succeed me, but now I must tell you plainly,

units.source_text: 我已经没有这个意思了。"

en.t: I no longer have any such intention."
